prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image1 is a FAILED FRONT projection of the crane. Image2 is the source master, small upper-right inset is the correct stowed travel machine. Correct the orientation of the upper crane so it is TRAVEL-ALIGNED fore-and-aft with tracks. Keep exact cab design, colors, twin crawler units, lower chassis, winch and general proportions from image1. ONE true FRONT drawing on white square, no insets/text.
The failure: image1 shows a LONG BOOM running LEFT-TO-RIGHT across entire picture while lower tracks/cab face forward. That upper carriage is incorrectly sideways. DELETE that horizontal side-view beam and its large circular SIDE faces. The ONE lowered telescoping boom must point straight TOWARD VIEWER, along chassis front-back axis, not sideways. Thus its LENGTH is FORESHORTENED/hidden in depth; visible boom END is a COMPACT rectangular teal/ivory/red end block just to VIEWER RIGHT of cab, above the hook travel cradle. It should occupy only about one-third of total vehicle width. Do not turn camera to reveal side length, do not shorten the physical boom into a short new crane. Long boom side surfaces should NOT span across the top.
Keep operator cab at FRONT VIEWER LEFT = vehicle RIGHT, unchanged ivory front/glass/red bumper. Winch at FRONT VIEWER RIGHT = vehicle LEFT remains, but new compact front boom tip is above it. Real pulley sheaves have lateral axes so front sees their narrow edges/stack, not a big round sheave disc facing camera.
Hook block must be reeved from those end sheaves by short vertical taut cables and LOCKED into a red travel bracket next to cab at its lower-window/bumper height. Remove the long free-hanging hook on far right. No hook below track level.
Rear counterweight projects behind cab/central deck, mostly occluded; don't retain huge unrelated ivory box sticking far left. Four outriggers stay stowed above tracks, TWO each side, not deployed legs. Do not add a second boom, cabin, wheels, water tanks or humanoid head. Direct front camera, compact complete square drawing, full tracks/boom/cab/margins. Same source ink/cel shading.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE exact SIDE source view of M07 municipal crawler crane in STOWED TRAVEL STATE. Input1 is master. Copy the small upper-right stowed travel image's parts, color, proportions and fold state; rotate it to true side. Large deployed crane is supporting detail reference ONLY; don't deploy its supports in this view.
Landscape 1536x1024 white, full machine centered with sensible margins. Front/cab and boom TIP point IMAGE RIGHT. True right-side profile, no front-face grille/windscreen turned toward viewer, only cab SIDE window and door, near and far tracks substantially overlap, far track at most a thin edge. No second subject, insets, labels/text.
Same low broad teal/ivory/red self-propelled crawler crane. TWO tracks total, one near loop with visible bogie rollers and continuous graphite tread, teal long side case. ONE cab at VEHICLE RIGHT FRONT (near), angular ivory door/front with blue glazing, teal sides, red lower frame, amber small service lamp. ONE rectangular telescoping boom STOWED horizontally along length of vehicle, rear central pivot over rear deck and long tip extending modestly past front cab; ivory top/teal side, red narrow border, red-white warning strip, real silver ram beneath. Keep original side elevation and overall length/height; do not create tall robot body.
Rear counterweight ivory with red corners at image LEFT. One cable winch is on VEHICLE LEFT upper carriage (FAR side in this right-side view), naturally occluded/only edge visible; do not copy the source perspective's near reel onto this side. FOUR stabilizer outriggers in total, TWO each side, fully folded closely along chassis above tracks. Near pair's short red/ivory folded foot blocks can show; no pads on ground, no extra robot legs.
Source's hook block reeved through boom tip sheaves with short taut cable and LOCKED into red front travel bracket ahead/beside cab, not hanging to ground. Cables terminate at winch/pulleys, no dangling unsupported pieces. Keep black hoses, silver rods, actual hinge joints, same clean ink, cel shading and service wear. Not a truck, no road wheels, weapons, water tanks or humanoid face.
